description: A defective application configuration is deployed to one service. The service starts but produces elevated errors for requests that hit the defective code path.
expected_root_cause: A defect introduced by the most recent deployment of the affected service.
expected_symptoms: error rate step-change immediately after deployment
deployment event in deployment_history.json aligns with error onset
expected_evidence: backend logs referencing the faulty code path
deployment_history.json entry for the service with matching timestamp
expected_resolution: Roll back to the previous version / remove the injected env var and restart.

deployment_context.note: See deployments/deployment_history.json. Replace SIMULATED commit ids with real git hashes if the repo has history.
